entry.title: Sol Next v9.0.3 Public (Build 903) — 免费内置原生加密 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash + 关 Wi-Fi 无线调试不断连
entry.summary: Sol Next v9.0.3 Public (Build 903, package ai.sol.next) introduces free built-in DeepSeek V4.1 Flash protected by a pure-Rust JNI ChaCha20+HMAC-SHA256+HKDF encrypted vault bound to APK Sig Block v2/v3 signing cert SHA-256 and procfs identity (zero plaintext keys in APK, OkHttp TLS SPKI certificate pinning + Proxy.NO_PROXY, anti-debug/anti-Frida guards, optional universal BYOK), plus permanent Wi-Fi-off Wireless Debugging Shell Helper persistence (auto-arming adb_enabled=1 + 127.0.0.1:5555 loopback before helper launch).

entry.title: Sol Next v9.0.2 Public (Build 902) — 多页查询对话式总结报告 + 首页作者联系方式 + OTA 版本修复

entry.title: Sol Next 9.0.3 vs Mika (wangzan101/Mika) — Full 14-Dimension Technical Comparison & Selection Guide
entry.summary: Objective engineering comparison between pioneer wangzan101/Mika and Sol Next 9.0.3 across 6 2K comparison charts and 14 measured dimensions, explaining when to choose Sol Next 9.0.3, when to choose original Mika, and how both coexist side-by-side on the same Android phone.
